body.description: Complete deployment target create/update payload used by the console, CLI, and Agent. Repository sources require repositoryBindingId; image sources require imageRef. Omitted optional fields use platform defaults.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Tri-state string; empty inherits the platform default.

autoScalingBehavior.description: JSON Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaler behavior object.

autoScalingMinReplicas.description: Minimum desired replicas. Zero enables HPA scale-to-zero.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Tri-state string controlling ServiceAccount token mounting; empty uses the Kubernetes default.

buildArgs.description: Newline-separated Docker build arguments in KEY=value form.

buildDefinitionMode.description: Selects the repository Dockerfile or a platform-rendered template Dockerfile.

buildDirectory.description: Optional working directory within the build context.

buildSecrets.description: Optional deployment-level secret updates. Existing keys with an empty value are retained; omitted keys are removed. Values are encrypted and never returned.

buildTemplateValues.description: JSON object containing validated template parameters.

buildTemplateVersion.description: Immutable built-in template version. An empty value selects the current version.

buildVariables.description: Optional deployment-level values that override matching application, project, and global keys.

capabilityAdd.description: JSON string array or line-separated Linux capabilities to add.

capabilityDrop.description: JSON string array or line-separated Linux capabilities to drop.

clusterId.description: Runtime cluster ID available to the project. Empty selects the platform default cluster.

configFiles.description: JSON array of runtime configuration file mounts.

containerArgs.description: JSON string array or line-separated container arguments.

containerCommand.description: JSON string array or line-separated container command.

cpuRequest.description: Kubernetes CPU quantity for each replica.

dataVolumes.description: Complete desired mount set. Omission or an empty array unbinds every existing deployment-volume mount; legacy storage fields and serialized JSON strings are rejected.

environmentVariables.description: Caller-selected public runtime environment variables. The platform does not infer sensitivity from key names or values. A key may also have a separately managed secret; the secret takes precedence in deployed workloads while both modes remain visible in API state. Choose the dedicated runtime secret action when encrypted storage and non-disclosure are required.

imageRef.description: Existing OCI image reference used when sourceType is image.

initContainers.description: JSON array of Kubernetes init containers.

memoryRequest.description: Kubernetes memory quantity for each replica.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the normalized stage.

namespace.description: Optional Kubernetes namespace override. Empty uses the project namespace.

repositoryBindingId.description: Required when sourceType is repository; must belong to the same application.

runtimeConfigSetIds.description: Legacy shorthand for live runtime configuration references.

secretFiles.description: JSON array of runtime secret file inputs. Existing plaintext values are never returned.

serviceAccountName.description: Optional Kubernetes ServiceAccount name used by the workload Pods.

servicePort.description: Legacy single-port projection of servicePorts[0]. New clients should use servicePorts.

servicePorts.description: Unique container service ports. This list is the authoritative port configuration.

sidecarContainers.description: JSON array of Kubernetes sidecar containers.

sourceType.description: Repository builds source code; image deploys an existing image directly.

stage.description: Immutable stage identifier, unique among active deployment targets in the application. Public create requests accept dev, test, staging, or prod and normalize production to prod. Updates to platform-managed components echo their existing sys-* value. A portable bundle may contain a historical non-public value, but preview/import require a public override. It may be reused after deletion cleanup.

targetImageRef.description: Combined target repository and tag for repository builds.

targetRegistryId.description: Registry credential used to push repository builds.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: JSON Kubernetes topology spread constraint array.

webConsoleEnabled.description: `null` inherits the project-space master switch and `false` disables Web Console for this deployment target.

items.description: One stored runtime environment value mode. Responses may contain public and secret entries with the same key; the secret entry takes precedence in deployed workloads.

value.description: Present only for public variables. Secret values and storage references are never returned.

status.description: Point-in-time Kubernetes observation. scaled-to-zero is an observed zero-desired-replica runtime, not a serving-ready state.

webConsoleEnabled.description: Nullable target restriction. Effective policy is `project.webConsoleEnabled && webConsoleEnabled != false`; a true value is treated as inheritance.

body.description: Complete deployment target create/update payload used by the console, CLI, and Agent. Repository sources require repositoryBindingId; image sources require imageRef. Omitted optional fields use platform defaults.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Tri-state string; empty inherits the platform default.

autoScalingBehavior.description: JSON Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaler behavior object.

autoScalingMinReplicas.description: Minimum desired replicas. Zero enables HPA scale-to-zero.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Tri-state string controlling ServiceAccount token mounting; empty uses the Kubernetes default.

buildArgs.description: Newline-separated Docker build arguments in KEY=value form.

buildDefinitionMode.description: Selects the repository Dockerfile or a platform-rendered template Dockerfile.

buildDirectory.description: Optional working directory within the build context.

buildSecrets.description: Optional deployment-level secret updates. Existing keys with an empty value are retained; omitted keys are removed. Values are encrypted and never returned.

buildTemplateValues.description: JSON object containing validated template parameters.

buildTemplateVersion.description: Immutable built-in template version. An empty value selects the current version.

buildVariables.description: Optional deployment-level values that override matching application, project, and global keys.

capabilityAdd.description: JSON string array or line-separated Linux capabilities to add.

capabilityDrop.description: JSON string array or line-separated Linux capabilities to drop.

clusterId.description: Runtime cluster ID available to the project. Empty selects the platform default cluster.

configFiles.description: JSON array of runtime configuration file mounts.

containerArgs.description: JSON string array or line-separated container arguments.

containerCommand.description: JSON string array or line-separated container command.

cpuRequest.description: Kubernetes CPU quantity for each replica.

dataVolumes.description: Complete desired mount set. Omission or an empty array unbinds every existing deployment-volume mount; legacy storage fields and serialized JSON strings are rejected.

environmentVariables.description: Caller-selected public runtime environment variables. The platform does not infer sensitivity from key names or values. A key may also have a separately managed secret; the secret takes precedence in deployed workloads while both modes remain visible in API state. Choose the dedicated runtime secret action when encrypted storage and non-disclosure are required.

imageRef.description: Existing OCI image reference used when sourceType is image.

initContainers.description: JSON array of Kubernetes init containers.

memoryRequest.description: Kubernetes memory quantity for each replica.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the normalized stage.

namespace.description: Optional Kubernetes namespace override. Empty uses the project namespace.

repositoryBindingId.description: Required when sourceType is repository; must belong to the same application.

runtimeConfigSetIds.description: Legacy shorthand for live runtime configuration references.

secretFiles.description: JSON array of runtime secret file inputs. Existing plaintext values are never returned.

serviceAccountName.description: Optional Kubernetes ServiceAccount name used by the workload Pods.

servicePort.description: Legacy single-port projection of servicePorts[0]. New clients should use servicePorts.

servicePorts.description: Unique container service ports. This list is the authoritative port configuration.

sidecarContainers.description: JSON array of Kubernetes sidecar containers.

sourceType.description: Repository builds source code; image deploys an existing image directly.

stage.description: Immutable stage identifier, unique among active deployment targets in the application. Public create requests accept dev, test, staging, or prod and normalize production to prod. Updates to platform-managed components echo their existing sys-* value. A portable bundle may contain a historical non-public value, but preview/import require a public override. It may be reused after deletion cleanup.

targetImageRef.description: Combined target repository and tag for repository builds.

targetRegistryId.description: Registry credential used to push repository builds.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: JSON Kubernetes topology spread constraint array.

webConsoleEnabled.description: `null` inherits the project-space master switch and `false` disables Web Console for this deployment target.

items.description: One stored runtime environment value mode. Responses may contain public and secret entries with the same key; the secret entry takes precedence in deployed workloads.

value.description: Present only for public variables. Secret values and storage references are never returned.

status.description: Point-in-time Kubernetes observation. scaled-to-zero is an observed zero-desired-replica runtime, not a serving-ready state.

webConsoleEnabled.description: Nullable target restriction. Effective policy is `project.webConsoleEnabled && webConsoleEnabled != false`; a true value is treated as inheritance.
